title: Cyberattack on Ceva Logistics exposes data of Steam hardware buyers
summary: The breach at the shipping company affects banks, retailers, and gamers, and Valve warns of possible fraudulent messages to European customers.

title: Meta returns to open AI models and criticizes its 'closed' rivals
summary: Zuckerberg announces the release of its most powerful model and plans to auction computing capacity to compete with China.

title: Rejection of 'AI slop' begins to have real effects
summary: Pressure against low-quality automated content is changing platform strategies and consumption habits.

title: Intel Core Ultra 200 processors drop to historic low prices
summary: The Core Ultra 5 250K Plus falls to $154 and the Core Ultra 7 270K Plus to $265 in retail deals.

title: Cooler Master launches a protector to prevent RTX 5090 GPUs from melting
summary: The GPU Shield, available in China for $50, includes a three-year warranty against melting of the 12V-2×6 connector.

title: Windows 11 weather app criticized for consuming over 1.2 GB of RAM and showing ads
summary: Users report that the built-in weather app is a web wrapper full of ads that abuses system memory.

title: AI data center bans surpass 500 across the United States
summary: New York and Texas join the local blocking of new facilities due to growing public and political opposition.

title: GeForce NOW vulnerability allows access to full Windows desktop
summary: A user exploits a file sharing feature in the cloud service to run local AI models with 48 GB of VRAM without restrictions.

title: Over 70% of Americans oppose AI data centers and protests increase
summary: Nearly 40 people have been arrested this year at demonstrations against the construction of AI factories in the country.

title: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive 2019 source code leaked
summary: Valve investigates the leak of the March 2019 CS:GO code, which could pose a risk to the game's security.

title: AMD FSR 4.1 improves image quality on Radeon RX 7000 at the cost of up to 18% performance
summary: Tests show the new upscaling reduces frame rate compared to FSR 3.1 and highlights that 8 GB of VRAM is insufficient for gaming.

title: PS4 and PS5 streaming comes to Steam Deck and Steam Machine with Asobi Remote Play
summary: The cloud gaming feature of PlayStation consoles is now available on Valve devices thanks to the Asobi app.

title: Anthropic enables Claude Code's automatic mode by default
summary: The company changes the configuration of its coding agent to execute actions automatically, sparking debate among developers.

title: Amazon pushes 7.65 GW gas plant in Texas to power AI data centers
summary: The facility, with 35 turbines, could emit 33 million tons of CO₂ per year and become the largest source of pollution in the U.S.
